description: This file defines the DesktopAppAPI class which provides an interface for interacting with the desktop application environment, including methods for popouts, notifications, theme updates, and event listeners within the Mattermost desktop app.

classes.name: DesktopAppAPI
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with the Mattermost desktop application environment, including popout management, notifications, theme updates, and event handling.

methods.name: setupDesktopPopout
methods.description: Sets up a desktop popout window with specified path and properties, returning handlers for communication and closure events.

methods.name: getAppName
methods.description: Returns the name of the desktop application.

methods.name: getAppVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the desktop application.

methods.name: getPrereleaseVersion
methods.description: Returns the prerelease version string if available.

methods.name: isDev
methods.description: Indicates whether the app is running in development mode.

methods.name: canPopout
methods.description: Indicates whether the app can pop out windows.

methods.name: getDesktopAppInfo
methods.description: Retrieves desktop app info via API or messaging.

methods.name: getBrowserHistoryStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the browser history navigation status.

methods.name: openPopout
methods.description: Opens a popout window with specified path and properties.

methods.name: canUsePopoutOption
methods.description: Checks if a specific popout option is available.

methods.name: getDarkMode
methods.description: Retrieves current dark mode status.

methods.name: onUserActivityUpdate
methods.description: Registers a listener for user activity updates.

methods.name: onNotificationClicked
methods.description: Registers a listener for notification click events.

methods.name: onBrowserHistoryPush
methods.description: Registers a listener for browser history push events.

methods.name: onBrowserHistoryStatusUpdated
methods.description: Registers a listener for updates to browser history navigation status.

methods.name: onReceiveMetrics
methods.description: Registers a listener for receiving system metrics.

methods.name: dispatchNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification through the desktop app or via fallback message.

methods.name: doBrowserHistoryPush
methods.description: Pushes a new path to browser history.

methods.name: updateUnreadsAndMentions
methods.description: Updates unread and mention counts.

methods.name: setSessionExpired
methods.description: Sets session expiration status.

methods.name: signalLogin
methods.description: Signals a login event.

methods.name: signalLogout
methods.description: Signals a logout event.

methods.name: reactAppInitialized
methods.description: Signals that the React app has initialized.

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Updates the desktop app theme.

methods.name: sendToParentWindow
methods.description: Sends a message to the parent window.

methods.name: sendToPopoutWindow
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific popout window.

methods.name: updatePopoutTitleTemplate
methods.description: Updates the title template for popouts.
